refundRequests.title: Refund requests
refundRequests.intro: Refunds asked of the payment provider. A refund is booked only when the provider confirms it. While a request waits, the payment cannot be refunded again.
refundRequests.reason.paidAfterEnd: Automatic: paid after the subscription ended
refundRequests.unknownHint: The provider did not answer, so it may have refunded. The request is checked every 15 minutes. If it is still unknown, check the provider's dashboard and resolve it here.
refundRequests.retryHint: Check your connection and try again.
refundRequests.empty.title: No refund requests
refundRequests.empty.unknownTitle: No refund with an unknown outcome
refundRequests.empty.body: Refunds that are waiting on the payment provider show up here.
refundRequests.resolve.title: Resolve this refund request
refundRequests.resolve.body: Record what the payment provider's dashboard shows. This is logged with your name. If the provider did refund, the refund is booked when its event arrives.
refundRequests.resolve.error: Could not resolve the refund request
refundRequests.resolve.notUnknown: Only a request with an unknown outcome can be resolved by hand.
refundRequests.resolve.tooSoon: The provider is still being asked. Try again 15 minutes after the request.
outcomeUnknown.title: Stripe never answered about some money
outcomeUnknown.body: Check each one in Stripe's dashboard, then settle it here. Nothing below is paid or refunded twice while it waits.
outcomeUnknown.refunds: {count, plural, one {# refund request} other {# refund requests}}
outcomeUnknown.transfers: {count, plural, one {# payout transfer} other {# payout transfers}}
outcomeUnknown.patronagePayouts: {count, plural, one {# patronage payout} other {# patronage payouts}}
refundRecheck.title: Ask Stripe about this refund again
refundRecheck.body: If Stripe shows no refund for this request, or a failed one, the request is released in your name and the payment can be refunded again. A refund Stripe made is booked when its event arrives.
refundRecheck.error: Could not check the refund with Stripe
refundRecheck.result.refunded: Stripe refunded it. It is booked when Stripe's refund event arrives.
refundRecheck.result.pending: Stripe is still processing the refund. Check again later.
refundRecheck.result.failed: Stripe's refund failed. The request is released.
refundRecheck.result.none: Stripe has no refund for this request. The request is released.
refundRecheck.result.ambiguous: Stripe lists refunds that do not match this request. Check the dashboard and resolve it by hand.
refundRecheck.result.unavailable: Stripe could not be asked. Try again later.
transferSettle.title: Settle this payout transfer
transferSettle.body: Look the transfer up in Stripe's dashboard and record what it shows. This is recorded with your name. You cannot settle your own payout.
transferSettle.outcome.notSent: Stripe has no transfer for it
transferSettle.referenceHint: Starts with tr_, as shown in Stripe's dashboard.
transferSettle.done.sent: Transfer recorded as sent. The payout is paid.
transferSettle.done.notSent: Transfer recorded as not sent. The amount is back in the creator's earnings.
